basic_details.job_title: DIC Young Professional: Cloud Technology Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) of Digital India Corporation invites applications for one post of Young Professional: Cloud Technology Engineer on a contractual basis. The post serves BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). The last date to apply is 10 December 2026, and the notice carries an Apply Here link.

qualification.details: B.S./B.E./B.Tech/M.S./ M.E./M.Tech/MCA in Technology subjects (preference for Computer Science, AI, Information Technology, or related fields) | Minimum 1 year of professional experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud integration, and configuration.

how_to_apply: Applications are to be made through the Apply Here link on the Openings Details page of the Digital India Corporation website, on or before 10 December 2026. The page also carries a Download Detailed Notification link for the full notice. The page does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: About DIC and BHASHINI
content_sections.text: Digital India Corporation runs this recruitment through its Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD). BHASHINI is an initiative of MeitY under the Digital India Program, undertaken as the National Language Translation Mission. It was launched by the Hon'ble PM on 4 July 2022 during Digital India Week 2022 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The notice states the vision of BHASHINI as to "Harness natural language technologies to enable a diverse ecosystem of contributors, partnering entities, and citizens for the purpose of transcending language barriers, thereby ensuring digital inclusion and digital empowerment in an Aatma Nirbhar Bharat."

content_sections.text: B.S./B.E./B.Tech/M.S./ M.E./M.Tech/MCA in Technology subjects (preference for Computer Science, AI, Information Technology, or related fields) Minimum 1 year of professional experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud integration, and configuration.
